dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY with REPLACING, INDEXED files, and Japanese EUC-encoded comments.
evidence: No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - inpatient (入院) receipt creation/editing for the JMA ORCA medical billing system
purpose.summary: ORCR0640 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software suite that processes inpatient (nyuuin) medical insurance receipts. It reads and writes indexed ISAM files (RECE62, RECE64, RECE65) containing receipt detail records, performing calculations for medical fees, patient co-payments, and various insurance billing codes. The program handles complex Japanese medical insurance billing rules including special dietary fees, regional public expense items, and partial burden amounts.

notable_features: 37 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax (GnuCOBOL style)
79 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprograms
420 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Multiple INDEXED ISAM files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Extensive flag and counter working-storage areas
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese EUC (decoded as latin-1, appearing as mojibake). The filename ORCR0640.CBL and copyright confirm this is part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software. Source truncated at 16000 chars but structure is clear from the visible portion.
